name: Fuji
source:
Blindly believes in miracles by the goddess, and the top of all humans belonging to the "Goddess Church"

Guru of "Goddess Church". Works hard to achieve the purpose of his goddess.

Calls Lily and her friends the "Devil's Children" instead of "Goddess's Children".

"The Goddess is equal as well. Sadly."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
